scope: Read-only source audit for real canonical14 TDZ error; no source/build/runtime edits.
observed: ReferenceError Cannot access p before initialization index.c392c541.js:18:9678
root_cause: DragTooltip destructures item/currentOffset from useDragLayer while its collector reads those outer uninitialized lexical bindings. useDragLayer synchronously uses useCollector -> useState(() => collect(monitor)) during first render. Not a circular import.
source_fix: Read item and currentOffset directly from monitor into collector-local variables before computeCanDrop and reuse in its return; remove unused outer item destructuring. Preserve original drag tooltip and service.
empty_drag: computeCanDrop explicitly returns allowDrop false if no dragNode type; no custom replacement is needed.
